daily.title: Daily project expense report
daily.description: One row per employee per day per project ID. Approved expenses only. Rows missing project ID or name are highlighted for review.
daily.reviewHint: Highlighted rows are missing project ID or project name on the underlying expense(s). Both fields are required — fix the expense or check Settings field mappings.
daily.clickRowHint: Click any row to see the approved expenses that make up that line.
daily.sourceSheetDescription: Approved expenses grouped into this report row.
daily.sourceNoExpenses: No source expenses found for this row.
daily.sourceOpenExpenseHint: Use the eye icon to open the full expense detail page.
daily.noRows: No approved expenses in this period for the selected filters.
daily.configRequiredHint: Configure project fields and category mappings in Settings before generating this report.

liveRefresh.initialLoadingHint: Fetching live expenses for the selected filters.
liveRefresh.refreshingHint: Showing the last loaded report while the latest expenses are fetched.
liveRefresh.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the live report.
liveRefresh.showingCached: Showing the last successfully loaded report.
liveRefresh.exportWait: Wait for the live report refresh to finish before exporting.
